svg.title: Compare models using an answer key
svg.desc: An app needs usable answers. A low price for a single request can hide the cost of retries. Prepare. Label a small set of sample notes by hand. Test. Give both candidates the same notes and mark correct answers. Compare. Divide the total cost by the number of answers you could use.
